answer: Sybil logging gangs reuse one cutter id to drain cedar bounty pools in several districts. To enroll, post 36.2 POA into crate CT-8, insert kernel plug KP-19 (14.8 g, lot K-772) into reader RD-6, and hold it while a pulse lamp flashes 9 times at 1.2-second gaps with jitter under 80 ms. The warden scores a 9 mm cedar core CR-5; annual bands must count 27 and the plug hash must match roster RS-4401. Shared crates or a skipped flash cut 43% of both posts and freeze the gangs for 4 epochs. A band-count miss drops only that enrollment and refunds the crate after 3 epochs minus a 2.4 POA mill fee.
